name: Ritz Carlton Montreal
insider_take: Montreal's most storied address, the Ritz-Carlton has reigned over Sherbrooke Street since 1912 — where Old World grandeur meets the electric pulse of one of North America's most culturally rich cities.
whats_special: A true piece of living history — Elizabeth Taylor and Richard Burton famously married here in 1964, and the hotel has hosted royalty, heads of state, and Hollywood legends for over a century. The iconic Duck Pond Garden remains one of Montreal's most beloved hidden gems, a serene courtyard oasis in the heart of the Golden Square Mile. Following a meticulous $200M restoration, the hotel seamlessly blends its Beaux-Arts heritage with sleek modern luxury — every detail is impeccably considered. MAISON Boulud, helmed by celebrated chef Daniel Boulud, delivers French-inspired cuisine in one of the city's most prestigious dining rooms.
pro_tip: Request a room or suite overlooking the legendary Duck Pond Garden — the peaceful courtyard view is a rare retreat from the city buzz, and utterly magical in every season, especially when the garden blooms in spring.
dont_miss: A cocktail at the Ritz Bar — an institution in its own right, beloved by Montrealers and travelers alike for decades. Exploring the Golden Square Mile directly outside, Montreal's most prestigious historic neighborhood lined with grand mansions, boutiques, and galleries. A visit to the nearby Montreal Museum of Fine Arts , just steps away and housing one of Canada's finest art collections.
pros: Prime downtown location in Montreal's Golden Square Mile
Legendary Ritz-Carlton service and luxury standards
Historic charm with modern amenities and elegant accommodations
Access to Marriott STARS Program exclusive benefits
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects high-end positioning
